old_caption: The video captures a serene scene of a cloudy sky with the sun prominently positioned near the center, casting a bright light that contrasts sharply with the surrounding darker clouds. A distinct halo effect is visible around the sun, caused by ice crystals in high-altitude cirrus clouds. Below the sky, a row of buildings is visible as silhouettes, with some showing flat roofs and others sloped ones. A few utility poles and wires run horizontally across the frame, adding to the urban landscape. The overall atmosphere is calm and somewhat overcast, suggesting either early morning or late afternoon. A watermark is present in the top-left corner, and the camera exhibits a very slight, slow drift or pan throughout the clip.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene scene of a cloudy sky with the sun prominently positioned near the center, casting a bright light that contrasts sharply with the surrounding darker clouds. The sky is filled with various shades of gray and white, indicating a mix of cloud types, some appearing denser and others more wispy. Below the sky, a row of buildings is visible, featuring a variety of architectural styles and colors, including green, blue, and white. Some buildings have flat roofs, while others have sloped ones. A few utility poles and wires run horizontally across the frame, adding to the urban landscape. The overall atmosphere is calm and somewhat overcast, suggesting either early morning or late afternoon. There are no animals or people present in the video, and the camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on the interplay between the sky and the buildings below.
caption: The video captures a hazy gray sky above dark rooftops, with power lines slanting across the lower frame. The sun sits near the center as a bright white disc, flanked by two pale side glows at the same height. A faint circular band surrounds the sun, while the two side patches remain aligned with it throughout the clip. Thin cloud layers drift slowly across the sky, changing the brightness and texture around the halo without moving the sun or its side glows. The rooftops and wires stay fixed in place, keeping the view steady as the sky shifts. In the upper-left corner, a red watermark badge appears, grows from a narrow mark into a rounded rectangle, and remains in position. The visible scene presents a stable sun-dog display under moving cloud cover, with the halo becoming slightly clearer as the thin veil shifts slowly.
